title: Compatibility with a change of position range
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers with $n+2=m+2$, let $p$ be a position in $\{0,\ldots,n+1\}$, and let $s\in\{-1,0,1\}$. Moving $p$ by $s$ with clamping to the valid position range and then identifying the ranges via the given equality gives the same position as first identifying the ranges and then moving by $s$ with clamping.
hypotheses_covered: A position p in the range of n + 2 positions
